tests.name: 4937无敌弱化魂印回复max三分一，溢出每整10授10源盾及下轮1%减伤，同源刷新异源保留

tests.name: 4937溢出按一般回复倍率处理，技能禁疗不影响魂印，真正回复归零不凭空产生溢出盾
tests.assertion: test('4937溢出按一般回复倍率处理，技能禁疗不影响魂印，真正回复归零不凭空产生溢出盾',()=>{for(const mode of['skillBan','cut','zero']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true,hp:8000});timer(s,1,'免弱');if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');else timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:mode==='cut'?.5:1});turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='zero'?8000:9000);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],source),mode==='skillBan'?2000:mode==='cut'?500:0);}});

tests.name: 4937魂印源盾存在且受击后仍存才核验清强，异源盾不冒充；当次破源盾明确待答
tests.assertion: test('4937魂印源盾存在且受击后仍存才核验清强，异源盾不冒充；当次破源盾明确待答',()=>{for(const kind of['own','foreign','break']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;S.refresh(s.fighters[0],kind==='break'?1:5000,kind==='foreign'?'foreign':source);if(kind==='break'){assert.throws(()=>turn(s,29433,10127),/Q-4937-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],source),1);}else{turn(s,29433,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,kind==='own'?0:2);}}});

tests.assertion: test('4937/882按正级种类每种加10威力而非等级总和，1198对手无负级才红伤加100%',()=>{const a=make(row(882)),b=make({...row(882),index:-1});for(const k of['atk','spe','acc']){a.fighters[0].stages[k]=6;b.fighters[0].stages[k]=6;}b.moveDefinitions[key(b.auditMoveId)].power+=30;turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));const damage=[];for(const weak of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1198));if(weak)s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);damage.push(sum(s));}assert.ok(Math.abs(damage[0]-damage[1]*2)<=2);});

tests.name: 4937/2366完整红伤严格高于300才当回合减回复100%，300不触发且效果到期
tests.assertion: test('4937/2366完整红伤严格高于300才当回合减回复100%，300不触发且效果到期',()=>{for(const cap of[300,301]){const s=make(row(2366));s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].power=2000;timer(s,0,'攻击输出上限',{amount:cap});let fraction=null;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)fraction=c.a.effects['回复效果削减']?.fraction??null;}};try{turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(sum(s),cap);assert.equal(fraction,cap===301?1:null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,cap===301?8699:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'],undefined);}});
